$comment: Copy to multi-agent-review.json in your project and edit. Every field is optional.
$comment_dirs: Leave these out and the tool keeps plans and transcripts in its own folder, away from the repository under review. Set them to put the output in your project instead; a relative path is resolved from where you run the command.
$comment_intake: Ticket mode. planner and fetcher default to the reviser when left out; tickets are always given as full URLs on the command line.

claude.$comment: bypassPermissions lets the reviser run the shell commands verification needs. A headless session cannot answer a permission prompt, so the cautious default refuses them instead. The guardrail is what bounds the blast radius either way - read the README before turning this on.

claude-mcp.$comment: Verified working headless: Claude Code reaches an authenticated MCP connector with acceptEdits plus an explicit allowedTools list, so a Jira fetch needs no shell access and no bypassPermissions. Replace the placeholders with the tool names your own tracker connector exposes - run the agent once interactively to see them. Nothing about your connector belongs in a committed config.

templates.$comment: Replace any prompt wholesale. Review placeholders: artifact, review, context, contextList, contextCount, round, date, workdir, stopOn, severities, severityLine. Intake placeholders: url, key, provider, ticket, ticketFile, artifact, workdir, date.
